title: Down Dog Streak Break Detection
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=downdog:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as sessions by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where gap_days>=4 AND sessions>0
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_break_days
description: Finds the longest gap of four or more days between Down Dog practice days after activity was established.
value: Streak breaks often precede full habit dropout; catching the gap early makes restarting easier.
implementation: Run daily on Down Dog session counts and alert when the quiet gap exceeds your restart threshold.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest practice break in days.
grandmaExplanation: It spots the longest stretch you went without doing Down Dog after you had been practicing regularly.
